scope: Read-only scientific/factual QA of all 30 v2 captions, immutable v3 raw receipts, the legacy pilot30-rendered.jsonl draft, and final pilot30-rendered-final.jsonl against pilot30-facts-v2.jsonl and each stored request payload.
counting_rule: Abbreviation-safe sentence count: sentence-ending .?! followed by whitespace plus an uppercase letter, or end-of-text; decimal points and the period in No. <number> do not count as sentence boundaries.

final_rendered_v3.changes: Removed three contradictory no-property-label clauses and two redundant polyhedra-sharing status clauses; structural composition, coordination, and graph claims remain.

notes: Allowed numeric rounding was accepted for structural cell and distance displays; original MP energy-above-hull values require exact preservation.
Omitted lattice, density, orbit labels, or local environments were not treated as failures when absent from the compact prompt.
Positive bonding, material-performance, and corner/edge/face-sharing claims were not found.
v2 mp-1217376 has an ambiguous phrase joining separate CN=12 cp and CN=3 C-neighbor environments; it is not counted as a contradiction; v3 omits the detail.
